parent_objective: materialize branch-specific response histories and wrong-history pairs for source interventions
blocked_by: M1279 admits one bounded no-training response-history materialization implementation
supersedes: direct policy training from current-frame source-intervention rows

public_gates: M1280 must preserve actor input contract
M1280 must not use private holdout
M1280 must materialize response histories and wrong-history pairs
M1280 must keep actor-view history free of fault/per-wheel/source labels
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add branch/fault labels to actor-view history
do not add per-wheel force scale slip or tire metadata to actor-view history
do not claim self-identification from source-history artifacts
do not claim high-fidelity validation from the compact pilot

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements no-training branch-specific response histories and wrong-history pair artifacts
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-history infrastructure only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if actor-view history leaks branch/fault labels
stop if wrong-history pairs are not same-pair opposite-condition swaps
stop if response distinguishability is absent
fallback_plan: if histories are valid and distinguishable, audit route to policy-side gate design
if histories are weak, route to prefix repair design

allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1280 creates history artifacts to address current-frame ambiguity but does not train or evaluate an actor.
history_necessity_tests: future policy-side gates must compare correct history to wrong history before self-ID claims
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: History evidence remains artifact-level until a policy-side gate uses these histories.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If response histories are not distinguishable, route to prefix repair rather than policy training.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The M1277 source interventions can be paired with branch-specific response histories and wrong-history swaps without actor-input leakage.
success_criteria: wrong-history rows swap to the opposite condition within the same pair
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: history actor-view fields include branch/fault/per-wheel labels
wrong-history rows are not same-pair opposite-condition swaps
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1280 passes as infrastructure if it materializes response-history artifacts and wrong-history pairs with clean actor-view history fields without training or actor-input expansion.
